items.pregunta: How can I book a tour?
items.respuesta: You can book directly through our WhatsApp button. Our team will assist you with availability, payment processing, and all the details needed for your experience.

items.pregunta: How far in advance should I book?
items.respuesta: We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance. During peak seasons, some tours may sell out quickly.

items.pregunta: Can I book for large groups?
items.respuesta: Yes! We organize experiences for couples, families, groups of friends, corporate events, and special occasions.

items.pregunta: Do I need to pay the full amount in advance?
items.respuesta: Depending on the tour, a deposit may be required to guarantee the reservation. Our team will inform you of the specific conditions for each experience.

items.pregunta: What is included in the tour price?
items.respuesta: Each tour includes different services. You will find detailed information about transportation, meals, activities, and other benefits in the description of each experience.
Many of our tours include land or sea transportation. Please check the specific details for each tour.
Yes. Many of our tours are family-friendly. If you are traveling with young children, contact us and we will recommend the best options for you.

politicaPrivacidad.titulo: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Processing

seccion1.descripcion: HR Tours Cartagena, identified and located in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia, is responsible for processing personal data collected through this website.

seccion2.descripcion: Through our reservation, quote, contact forms, and direct chat (WhatsApp), we may request the following information:
seccion2.item2: Email address and phone / WhatsApp number.
seccion2.item4: Travel dates, booking details, accommodation, and special requirements for tours.
seccion2.item5: Browsing data (cookies, IP address, and web analytics).

seccion3.descripcion: The collected data is used exclusively to:
seccion3.item1: Manage, confirm, and provide requested tourist services and day passes.
seccion3.item2: Respond to inquiries, quotes, and provide personalized customer service.
seccion3.item3: Send booking confirmations, itineraries, and travel recommendations.
seccion3.item4: Process payments and validate transaction security.
seccion3.item5: Comply with legal requirements from tourism and tax authorities in Colombia.
seccion3.item6: Improve the browsing experience on our website through anonymous analytics.

seccion4.titulo: 4. Rights of Data Subjects (Law 1581 of 2012 / Habeas Data)
seccion4.descripcion: As the owner of personal data, you have the right to:
seccion4.item1: Know, update, and rectify your personal data at any time.
seccion4.item2: Request proof of the authorization granted for processing your data.
seccion4.item3: Be informed about how your information has been used.
seccion4.item4: Revoke authorization or request the deletion of your data when there is no legal or contractual duty to retain it.
seccion4.item5: File complaints with the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC) of Colombia in case of legal violations.

seccion5.descripcion: Our website includes direct links to WhatsApp to facilitate immediate communication. By clicking these links, you will be redirected to the WhatsApp platform (Meta), which operates under its own privacy policies. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for advertising purposes outside HR Tours Cartagena.

seccion6.descripcion: We use technical and analytical cookies (such as Google Analytics) to understand how visitors interact with the page and improve user experience. You can disable cookies at any time from your browser settings.

seccion7.descripcionPre: To exercise your rights to access, update, rectify, or delete data, you can send a request to our contact email specifying the subject
